missionPremise: Operator ruling 2026-08-18 / 2026-08-19, dispatched under OPS-16 amendments A-018 and A-019: the County Manifest must be a LIVE FEED, not a four-day-old snapshot, and the console exists so defects are spotted rather than hand-found. The operator opened it, could not find the sweep behind its subtab, and separately had to ask whether footprints were ingested — a question the console should have answered on sight. There are THREE layers, not two, and all three disagree independently: WRITTEN (atoms in the store), SCORED (county_facet_coverage via GET /api/county-ledger), SERVED (what Smart Site shows a human). The divergences between them ARE the defect list.
completionPredicate: On the County Manifest a stranger can (a) read WRITTEN, SCORED and SERVED side by side for the same county and rail, each carrying its own origin, timestamp and denominator, with no cross-layer arithmetic; (b) find the subtabs without being told and land on one from a URL; (c) see staleness as an alarm that names what it invalidates; (d) find the three dead indicators either derived or deleted, with the deletion stated on screen; (e) read every rail against its own reachable ceiling rather than against 254. ALL MET, with one half of (a) bounded by a lane dependency named below.
scopeBasis: File ownership was apps/command-center/** only; four other lanes are running in this repo. `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD | grep -v '^apps/command-center/' | wc -l` returns 0. No server route, no proxy allowlist rule (root api/spine.ts) and no package outside the app was touched: both new reads are GETs the proxy already allows on the cortex and retrieval segments. The serving-sweep ENDPOINT is SS-W7 and the sweep DATA is P-43; neither was attempted.

The served field is still read and its disagreement with the derivation is COUNTED on screen rather than resolved silently.

RAIL SCORING EVIDENCE — does ANY county in the payload carry a coverage number, a source or a verifying instrument for this rail. Replaces the hand-declared NO WRITER tag. Fires on 6 of 14 rails and stays quiet on 8, so it is proven able to do both on live data.

STALENESS AGE and EVIDENCE HORIZON — computedAt against the console clock, and against every other observation on screen. The horizon check fires only when an observation postdates computedAt, which is the one thing that proves the ledger is behind the world.
RAIL DENOMINATORS — acquisition scored against railCapabilities[].maxCountiesReachable where a probe defines one, absences counted beside it, and a flag where acquisition alone exceeds the ceiling.
LAYER COVERAGE — how many rows of the join each layer actually measured, with its named non-measurements.
DIVERGENCE CLASSES — five classes, each tallied over the whole join so a zero is a measured zero.
stillHandDeclaredAndSaidToBeSo: hasWriter and atomFamilyState — declared in the engine manifest, uniform across all 3,556 cells, recomputed by nothing. The controls they drove are DELETED; the raw values remain visible in the cell drawer marked declared-upstream. This console cannot fix them.
thresholdPct — a policy number per rail. Correctly hand-set; named as declared so nobody reads it as measured.

DECLARED_WORK — the work-horizon list introduced by this lane. One entry, carrying its completedAt, its doc_repo artifact path and a declaredAt, rendered with provenance 'declared'. It rots by design and says so.

RAIL_LABELS, texasCountyNames.ts, railFieldMap.ts and the new WRITTEN_SIGNALS map — presentation and correspondence judgements declared in this repo. WRITTEN_SIGNALS carries a basis per row and every rail it does not speak for is enumerated as its own class, so a rail with no signal renders as UNMEASURED and never as empty.

howStalenessIsSurfaced.shape: an alarm bar at the top of EVERY subtab, not a banner on one. Collapsed to a headline when nothing is firing, expanded by default at danger.
howStalenessIsSurfaced.eachAlarmCarries: a severity, a provenance chip reading derived or declared, a headline, a 'proves' clause stating what it does and does NOT establish, and a basis naming the field, URL or repo path it came from.
theThreeChecks: AGE (derived) — fires warn at 15 minutes and danger at 24 hours. On the live payload it reads 'the ledger is 4d 20h 12m old — every one of the 3,556 cell states below is a claim about 2026-08-14T17:41:22.500Z, not about now'. Its proves clause says only that the snapshot is old.

EVIDENCE HORIZON (derived) — fires when any observation the console can see postdates computedAt, naming the instrument, what it saw and when. Its proves clause states that the snapshot cannot contain them and explicitly that it does not prove any particular cell is wrong. On today's data it stays quiet, because both other instruments are OLDER than the ledger; it fires the moment SS-W7's sweep lands.

DECLARED WORK HORIZON (declared) — fires when a declared work record postdates computedAt and the ledger still reports that rail unacquired. On the live payload it reads that the ledger predates declared work on footprint and reports it unacquired on 254 of 254 cells.
howStalenessIsSurfaced.alsoInTheHeader: the panel's right-hand pill reads 'ledger 4d 20h 12m old' instead of a satisfied count whenever anything is firing.

workItemsAgainstTheDispatch.item: 1. Render written / scored / served side by side per rail per county
workItemsAgainstTheDispatch.detail: New Three layers subtab. Nothing averaged, nothing blended. The ONLY subtraction across layers is scored-minus-served in points, where both sides are percentages of parcels; a written ATOM COUNT is never differenced against a scored PERCENTAGE and the reading says so in words. Five divergence classes, each measured over the whole join. A layer with no instrument for a cell renders a named non-measurement in four distinct flavours per layer, never a zero.

workItemsAgainstTheDispatch.item: 2. Wire the live sweep feed once SS-W7 lands GET /api/serving-sweep; keep the artifact origin labelled
workItemsAgainstTheDispatch.detail: The console auto-probes the sweep once, the first time a view needs the SERVED layer, so the operator does not have to find a button. Today that probe returns the SPA fallthrough and renders a named not-served state carrying the URL and status. SS-W6's two labelled origins are preserved and a loaded artifact is asserted by test never to carry the word LIVE.

A labelled, bordered segmented control with a '3 views' lead-in, raised active segment, per-tab status badge, role=tablist / role=tab with aria-selected, arrow-key navigation, and a URL param so a view is linkable and survives reload (#panel=county-manifest&view=three-layer). A hash naming a view that does not exist falls back rather than blanking the panel.
See howStalenessIsSurfaced above. The footprint case is the worked example and fires on the live payload.

workItemsAgainstTheDispatch.item: 5. The three dead indicators — derive them or delete them
workItemsAgainstTheDispatch.detail: isPartial DERIVED (fires on 120 of 3,556). hasWriter's NO WRITER tag DELETED and replaced by derived scoring evidence (fires on 6 of 14 rails). atomFamilyState's NO ATOM tag DELETED with no manifest replacement — atom presence is a WRITTEN-layer question, answered on the Three layers subtab by an instrument that reads the store. Both deletions are rendered on screen with their driver, their reason, their denominator and their replacement, because a control that vanishes silently leaves the state it named looking monitored.

workItemsAgainstTheDispatch.item: 6. Score every rail against its railCapabilities reachable ceiling, never against 254
workItemsAgainstTheDispatch.state: DONE, with a correction the dispatch did not anticipate
workItemsAgainstTheDispatch.detail: Acquisition scores against the ceiling: rrc-wells now reads 0/1, not 0/254. The correction: counting established absences inside that fraction read mud 209/186. An absence is not bounded by how far an acquisition source reaches, so absences are counted beside acquisition, and a case where acquisition ALONE exceeds the ceiling is flagged, since then the capability probe and the coverage scorer cannot both be right.

contradictsThisBriefing.briefing: The County Manifest must become a LIVE FEED.
contradictsThisBriefing.atSource: Half of that is not in this repo. county_facet_coverage moves only when an engine block or scorer runs, and no recompute route exists on the deployed cortex-api. Calling the current state 'live' without that caveat would be the exact defect the programme is hunting.

openAndRoutedToThePlanner.item: The ledger cannot be recomputed from any console. Until SS-W7's route lands, the live feed is a live READ of a frozen snapshot and the console says so on every view. The moment that route exists, the feed picks up a moving computedAt with no further console change.

There is no statewide WRITTEN instrument. The only one reachable covers 10 counties of 254 and speaks for 4 rails of 14, and it took 240s to fail on one of two probes. A statewide store-contents endpoint — even a slow, cached, per-county count by atom family — would turn the three-layer view from a Central-Texas sample into the statewide defect list the operator asked for.
